DiscordComponentEmbedEnabled.description: Whether Discord component link previews are published at all.

DiscordComponentEmbedDescriptionBudget.description: Character budget for a preview description, applied to the component payload and to og:description alike.

DiscordComponentEmbedThumbnailWidth.description: Width, in pixels, that preview thumbnails are rendered at. The same bound PageImages uses for its own og:image.

DiscordComponentEmbedNamespaces.description: Namespace IDs that get previews, as returned by NamespaceInfo::getValidNamespaces(). Null means every namespace.

DiscordComponentEmbedOpenGraph.description: Whether to add Open Graph fallback tags for keys no other source on the wiki emits.

DiscordComponentEmbedComponents.description: Whether to publish the component payload. Off leaves the Open Graph tags alone, and Discord renders its own card: a larger clickable title, the description and the image, without buttons, gallery or accent.

DiscordComponentEmbedTitleHeading.description: Heading level the card's header is rendered at: 0 for body size, 1 to 3 for a heading, which is the only way a component's title gets bigger.
